worst.subject: character:char_mademoiselle_de_la_poche
worst.why: She is only mentioned in passing as a vendor of brushes and patches.

worst.subject: character:char_tire_woman
worst.why: They merely sent for the best tire-woman they could get, without establishing her presence.

worst.subject: relationship:rel_002
worst.why: The excerpt establishes he had a daughter, but does not identify this daughter specifically as Cinderella.

worst.subject: relationship:rel_018
worst.why: The king and queen are mentioned together, but their marital relationship is not explicitly stated.

worst.subject: seed:char_gentlemans_first_wife
worst.why: The text does not explicitly state that the first wife is dead, only that he had a child by another wife who was the best creature.
